translation: Flavor salty, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat sudden wind-stroke and cold-damage, body heat with distending fullness, mania-pathogen causing sudden unconsciousness of others (忽忽不知人), warm-malaria with the dripping shiver, blood-masses (血瘕) and cold blood, dispel qi within the chest, down-drive water, stop vexation and thirst, disperse swellings below the neck, abscesses and swellings, ...
